query.title: Company/business name or owner name
query.description: A company/business name (or partial name) to search for, or -- when searchType is 'individual' -- a person's name.

queries.title: Names to search
queries.description: Multiple names to search for in one run. Combined with 'query' if both are set.

searchType.title: Search type
searchType.description: 'entity' searches registered companies and business names (COY-/BRN- registration numbers). 'individual' searches registered business owners/proprietors by their own name, and can also fetch every business each owner is registered against.

includeOwnerDetails.title: Include owner detail (individual searches only)
includeOwnerDetails.description: When searchType is 'individual', also fetch each matched owner's public detail page and include the ID type and the full list of businesses they are registered against. Ignored for entity searches (no public detail page exists for companies -- see README).

maxResultsPerQuery.title: Max matches per query
maxResultsPerQuery.description: Maximum number of matched entities/individuals to return per search query.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrent workers
maxConcurrency.description: How many search queries to run in parallel.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify Proxy configuration. Residential is on by default.
